subject: Payables hand-off, PO cadence & procurement intake (next steps)
messages:
From: Elaine Morris <elaine.morris@healthco.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@healthco.com
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up from demo — procurement questions and timeline

Thanks again for the demo this morning, Sofia — the team found the latency/cost breakdown helpful. Quick follow-up items from procurement and payables that I want to confirm so we can advance to a pilot: 

1) PO / invoicing cadence: we need to know if Redwood can invoice monthly via PO or if you require a single upfront invoice for pilot/po. Our payables team is strict about PO numbers attached to invoices.

2) Vendor intake: procurement asked for a vendor intake form + SOC2 evidence, and they want to know if you have a standard SOW template for pilots.

3) Decision owner: who will be the economics owner for final sign-off? I can loop them in once we have the procurement checklist.

Can you confirm the above and share the intake docs? Target timing from our side: procurement has a window the week of May 31 to get vendors into the system. If Redwood can meet that cadence, we can aim for a June pilot start.

Thanks —
Elaine
Procurement Lead | HealthCo
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Morris <elaine.morris@healthco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo — procurement questions and timeline

Hi Elaine — great to meet you on the call. Appreciate the clear asks; summarizing so we're aligned and so Marissa/Rishi can pick up on the ops side.

Short answers up front:
- Invoicing: We can support monthly invoices tied to a PO for pilots. We typically issue net-30 invoices with PO on the invoice header.
- Vendor intake & security: attaching a brief SOC2 summary and our pilot SOW template for your procurement team to review. If you need the full SOC2 report we can start an NDA-based data room exchange — Rishi can coordinate.
- Economic owner: please confirm the contact and we'll add them to the mutual action plan; see suggested next steps below.

Attached: redwood-sow-template.pdf, soc2-summary.pdf

Suggested immediate next steps (short list):
1) Elaine: share the HealthCo vendor intake spreadsheet and the PO workflow (who raises POs and estimated lead time).
2) HealthCo: provide econ buyer contact (name + email) and preferred invoice remit details.
3) Redwood (Marissa): prepare a one-page pilot commercial summary and draft invoice example for procurement (will include PO field).
4) Redwood (Rishi): start SOC2/full-evidence intake and share NDA/drive link if needed.

Timing: if procurement can accept our monthly PO invoicing and we have vendor intake returned by May 26, we can target a PO issued May 31 and pilot kickoff the week of June 7. If the intake slides, we'll adjust.

I'll hold on next steps and loop in legal if procurement asks to review contract redlines.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0128

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 14:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo — procurement questions and timeline

Sofia / Rishi — quick ops note after reviewing the SOC2 summary and the SOW draft. Suggested commercial/ops path to keep HealthCo in the May 31 intake window: 

- I will draft a one-page pilot commercial with expected monthly invoicing and a sample invoice layout that includes the PO number field. Aim to share by EOD tomorrow (5/21).
- Rishi: please outline the minimal evidence set procurement needs to approve vendor intake (SOC2 sections, encryption/custody contacts). If procurement needs the full SOC2, that will require an NDA + secure share.
- Contingency: if procurement requires net-60 or special payment terms, we can escalate to finance for credit approval — would need econ buyer sign-off.

Open question for Sofia: do we want to propose a two-month pilot (60k token cap) vs. a time-boxed 30-day trial? Procurement often prefers a time-boxed financial commitment they can map to a PO. My recommendation: propose a 30-day pilot with optional renewal to simplify PO sizing.

I'll also prepare a short checklist for payables:
- Vendor name + remit address
- W9 or equivalent tax doc
- PO template and billing contact
- Primary SOW pdf + pilot acceptance criteria

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success - Enterprise | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Elaine Morris <elaine.morris@healthco.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo — procurement questions and timeline

Thanks, Sofia and Marissa — this is helpful. Two quick confirmations from procurement: 

1) Econ buyer: Evan Hughes (evan.hughes@healthco.com) is the economics owner and will review the pilot commercial. I'll intro him on Monday unless you want to include him on this thread now.
2) Vendor intake form: attaching our intake spreadsheet (healthco-vendor-intake.xlsx). Our payables team is comfortable with monthly invoices tied to a PO number as long as the invoice shows the PO and remit address.

We prefer a 30-day pilot for PO sizing — Evan will weigh in if he wants a longer commitment. Target: procurement will complete intake by May 26 if we receive the SOW and the vendor intake back today.

Attaching: healthco-vendor-intake.xlsx
